description: This file contains API client functions for user-related operations, including fetching user projects and basic user info, with detailed parameters and error handling.

methods.name: getUserProjects(userId, params = {})

methods.description: Fetches minimal user info by MongoDB ObjectId, returning a Promise with user id and name, handling not found errors gracefully.
